headline: ASML posts a record quarter, Microsoft ships a monster patch drop, Ubisoft keeps cutting, and F1 confirms it's heading back to Africa with a Rwanda Grand Prix.

items.headline: ASML posts a record quarter and raises the bar for Q4
items.summary: Q3 revenue hit €11.7bn with €5bn net profit, and it shipped 113 lithography systems (up from 86). Q4 guidance of €14.2–15.2bn suggests AI chip demand is holding up despite this week's chip-stock wobble.

items.headline: Patch Tuesday: Microsoft fixes 1,400+ bugs, one already exploited
items.summary: The October drop covers 1,413 vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited Windows Mark-of-the-Web bypass (CVE-2026-96951). Ivanti Connect Secure VPNs also have an exploited auth-bypass zero-day, so network kit wants attention too.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Argon goes broadly available
items.summary: Google's new model is now open to everyone, with introductory API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output. Separately, OpenAI and Anthropic backed binding AI safety rules at a UK parliamentary hearing.

items.headline: Japan puts up to $21bn into GlobalFoundries fabs in New York
items.summary: Two new chip plants will be jointly owned by Japanese interests and the US government, whose GlobalFoundries stake rises to about 7%. Renesas and Apple are tipped as customers, though nothing is signed.

items.headline: Webb finds an unusually dense, dark-matter-heavy galaxy cluster
items.summary: JWST observations reveal a massive early structure packed more tightly with dark matter than models comfortably allow, adding to the list of 'too big, too early' puzzles.

items.headline: Light caught spinning and twisting in empty space
items.summary: Physicists report light beams developing self-twisting structure as they travel through free space, with no material needed to shape them — potentially useful for optical communications and trapping particles.

items.headline: Fossils reveal a giant prehistoric snake from India
items.summary: Researchers describe a newly identified giant snake from Indian fossil beds, another heavyweight from the era when snakes rivalled today's anacondas.

items.headline: Dragon arrives at the ISS this afternoon
items.summary: CRS-35, carrying the station's final iROSA solar arrays and a batch of experiments, is due to dock around 16:00 Irish time.

sections.title: Gaming
sections.summary: Nothing new on the watchlist (Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3, Borderlands).

items.headline: Ubisoft proposes closing RedLynx and cuts 70 in Singapore
items.summary: The Trials studio in Finland faces closure, and voluntary departures are now on offer at the German teams behind Anno and The Settlers too.

items.headline: Rockstar: future games won't take as long as GTA VI
items.summary: A senior developer says the next projects will move faster than GTA VI's roughly eight-year cycle, and the publishing head says staff can unionise if they want to.

items.headline: Xbox launches 'Xbox Labs' to try out new ideas
items.summary: A new team for experimental projects arrives as CEO Asha Sharma reportedly told staff Xbox can't survive on reviving old franchises alone.

sections.title: BJJ & Grappling
sections.summary: Quiet on the mats: no major events or big news in the last 48 hours.

items.headline: Quiet week on the mats
items.summary: Only regional opens are on before the weekend, with no major pro cards or headline signings in the last two days. Last week's UFC BJJ 12 recap is in yesterday's archive.

sections.title: MMA
sections.summary: Fight week in Edmonton; little else breaking.

items.headline: UFC Edmonton fight week: Buckley vs Malott on Saturday
items.summary: Home favourite Malott faces Buckley, who's looking to snap a losing run; Blanchfield vs Jasudavicius is the co-main. The main card starts at 01:00 Irish time Sunday.

items.headline: Pimblett's 2026 return looks unlikely
items.summary: Liverpool's Paddy Pimblett says he's in no rush back after the Gaethje loss and is eyeing a Topuria fight next year, with his 2026 hopes fading.

items.headline: Volkanovski and Evloev trade warnings ahead of UFC 333
items.summary: The featherweight title fight headlines on 24 October; Volkanovski says Evloev's wrestling-heavy game plan will fade after a round or two.

items.headline: F1 is going back to Africa: Rwanda lands a 10-year deal
items.summary: A purpose-built circuit at Bugesera, near Kigali, will host an African Grand Prix from the early 2030s, the first F1 race on the continent since 1993.

items.headline: McLaren to hold more Norris–Piastri talks after Singapore clash
items.summary: The team confirmed further discussions with both drivers after their collision in Singapore, and is also reviewing Piastri's unusual puncture.

items.headline: Verstappen's GT debut entry list is out
items.summary: The full field for Saturday's GTWC Europe finale at Portimão is confirmed, with Max sharing Team Verstappen Racing's Mercedes-AMG GT3. Racing is 17:00–20:00 Irish time.
